_comment: Phase 4.1, the years turn (LifeSystem). A year is the calendar's (four seasons, data/society.json); everyone ages on their birthday. The tone is gentle: children never die, and no one dies giving birth. Chances are per year and are spread over its days.

ages._comment: teen: children take up their family's teen job (an apprentice, a farmhand). adult: CharacterData.ADULT_AGE, they take a grown trade. retire: commoners leave work for an elder's life (nobles and retainers keep their place).

trades._comment: When someone with a trade retires, dies or leaves, a grown son or daughter carries it on, else one of the village's hands (territory.json "hiring"). At 16 an apprentice takes up the family trade this often; otherwise a trade of their background.
trades._food: While the village grows less food than it eats plus this share of what it eats, young people coming of age work the fields (food_job) rather than a trade, and hands who grow food aren't taken from the fields for other trades.

death._comment: Yearly chance of dying by age (straight lines between the points). Never below min_age. Old age names the cause from old_age_from; before that it's an illness, rarely. The player lives on the same curve (Phase 4.3, data/succession.json); spare_player keeps them alive (a testing switch).

mourning._comment: Happiness while they grieve someone close (MoodSystem), for this many days.

courtship._comment: Unmarried villagers (not the ruling family or retainers: the house's matches come in 4.2) may start courting someone of a compatible age; a courtship of at least min_days may turn into a marriage. Yearly chances.

births._comment: A married couple may have a child while the mother is between the ages; the yearly chance falls with each child they already have (by), never sooner than spacing_days after the last, and less in a crowded home or a full village.

leaving._comment: When more people live here than the charter allows, young unmarried adults may move away to seek their fortune (yearly chance).

looks._comment: Growing up and growing old: men may grow a beard at beard_age; from grey_from, hair may turn grey each birthday.
